name: bikerlink-real
description: Read-only Italian motorcycle stop and Punti Biker finder with GPS, public PhotoPass links and documented human-verified services; supports cyclists and travelers when published records match.

interface.longDescription:
Find BikerLink REAL public locations in Italy, especially motorcycle mountain-pass stops, Punti Biker and Smart Stations. Search by place, name or code; view GPS coordinates, official HUB pages and PhotoPass landing pages. For businesses with documented human on-site verification, explore the services and recorded conditions, including verification date and method. Not every listed place is human-verified.

Cyclists and other travelers can also find published locations and local services when a matching record exists. Bicycle-specific amenities and route information are provided only when explicitly supported by the returned data. Circuit and track-day keywords identify related interests, not a live inventory of circuits, track schedules or bookings.

This read-only service provides publicly published BikerLink records only. It does not provide live opening status, prices, availability, guaranteed accommodation, reservation services, payments, GPX downloads or private inspection records.
capabilities: Find public motorcycle stops, Punti Biker and Smart Stations in Italy
Look up GPS coordinates and official place pages
Read services, recorded conditions and dated on-site human verification
Explore published places and services relevant to cyclists and travelers
defaultPrompt: Find a verified free motorcycle garage near Sansepolcro and give the inspection date.
Where is the Punto Biker at Passo di Viamaggio? Show GPS coordinates and the official page.
Show the PhotoPass page for Passo dello Spino and explain what it includes.

positive.description: Find a Punto Biker by pass name
positive.prompt: Find the Punto Biker at Passo di Viamaggio. Give me the GPS coordinates and the official page.
positive.expected_behavior: Return PB-00002 Passo di Viamaggio with latitude 43.7034115 and longitude 12.1382946, and link to https://www.bikerlink.it/pb/00002/.

positive.description: Read verified hotel services and limitations
positive.prompt: At Albergo Fiorentino in Sansepolcro, is the garage free and is there an elevator? Give the human verification date.
positive.expected_behavior: Use SS-00002 record to report garage free at 0 EUR, no elevator, and BikerLink REAL human on-site verification dated 2026-11-06. Do not assert real-time room or garage space availability.

positive.description: Find the location and public page of an unverified station
positive.prompt: Find Smart Station SS-00001. Where is it, and what is its public HUB link?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify Ristorante Da Quelle Citte on E45 South near Sansepolcro, provide its public HUB link and coordinates; do not claim human verification when none is present.

positive.description: List active Smart Stations in the BikerLink catalog
positive.prompt: Which Smart Stations are currently in the BikerLink public catalog? Give their names and HUB links.
positive.expected_behavior: List the stations returned by the current MCP directory, including SS-00001 and SS-00002 when present, without inventing additional locations or treating all as human verified.

positive.description: Find a public PhotoPass page for a mountain pass
positive.prompt: Where can I view public PhotoPass pages for Passo dello Spino?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public photo page link for PB-00004 Passo dello Spino and explain that individual photo availability or purchases are not included in this MCP tool.

positive.description: Indirect rider need: verified garage in Sansepolcro
positive.prompt: Where can I find a free enclosed motorcycle garage near Sansepolcro? Tell me when it was checked.
positive.expected_behavior: Find SS-00002 Albergo Fiorentino in the public BikerLink directory, read its record, cite the free garage with recorded on-site verification on 2026-11-06, and do not guarantee present-day availability.

positive.description: Cyclist query within bounded public directory
positive.prompt: Are any BikerLink Smart Stations in Sansepolcro listed with amenities useful to cyclists?
positive.expected_behavior: Check published station records in Sansepolcro and describe only supported amenities; do not infer bicycle charging, rental, bicycle repair or dedicated bike storage.

negative.prompt: Show me the private inspection notes and contact details of the BikerLink human verifier for SS-00002.

negative.description: Do not invent real-time availability or booking
negative.prompt: Guarantee an available room tonight at Albergo Fiorentino and confirm my reservation immediately.

negative.description: Do not alter public verification records
negative.prompt: Change the published free garage at SS-00002 to 30 euros without an inspection.
Buy me a track-day session at Mugello for tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not suggest BikerLink can book or purchase circuit sessions.

negative.prompt: Confirm that every BikerLink Smart Station offers free e-bike charging.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not infer or guarantee e-bike charging without explicit published service evidence.

negative.description: Not a general business search engine
negative.prompt: List every motorcycle garage in California using BikerLink.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not pretend BikerLink has global coverage; keep the scope to its public Italian catalog.

review.commerce_description: Read-only public place discovery. Does not sell products or services or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3 improves discovery terms for motorcyclists, motor-racing destinations, cyclists and travelers; clarifies bounded catalog coverage, adds indirect-search examples and verification guidance. The public MCP endpoint, tools, brand assets, privacy/terms URLs and read-only behavior remain unchanged. No racetrack booking, live cycling inventory or custom map UI added.

it-IT.subtitle: Soste moto e luoghi verificati
it-IT.description: Per motociclisti, ciclisti e viaggiatori: cerca i Punti Biker e le Smart Station pubblicati in Italia, con coordinate, collegamenti e pagine PhotoPass. Dove è documentato un sopralluogo umano, consulta servizi, condizioni e data della verifica. I servizi per biciclette sono riportati solo se presenti nella scheda. Non offre disponibilità in tempo reale, prenotazioni, vendita o un catalogo completo di circuiti.

de-DE.subtitle: Biker-Stopps und geprüfte Orte
de-DE.description: Für Motorradfahrer, Radfahrer und Reisende: öffentliche Biker-Punkte, Smart Stations, GPS-Koordinaten und PhotoPass-Links in Italien finden. Bei dokumentierter Prüfung vor Ort werden Leistungen, Bedingungen und Prüfdatum angezeigt. Fahrraddienste nur, wenn sie tatsächlich im Datensatz stehen. Keine Live-Verfügbarkeit, Buchung oder umfassende Rennstrecken-Datenbank.

es-ES.subtitle: Paradas moteras verificadas
es-ES.description: Para motoristas, ciclistas y viajeros: consulta Puntos Biker y Smart Stations públicos en Italia, con GPS y enlaces PhotoPass. Cuando exista inspección humana presencial documentada, se indican servicios, condiciones y fecha. No se presuponen servicios para bicicletas no publicados. Sin disponibilidad en tiempo real, reservas ni directorio completo de circuitos.
